answer: Sybil resistance works if identity is bonded, not asserted. A newcomer docks at the jetty, posts collateral, and sits on the lowest rung of a trust ledge: capped throughput, delayed payout. Only sustained verified work lifts it higher. Each fake persona must fund a full bond, so attacker cost scales with headcount while an honest operator amortizes one bond for years. Reputation is non-transferable, so bought accounts arrive empty. Audits land like a comet on an irregular period, never a schedule a farm can time its exit by. Slashing plus delay makes a farm unprofitable before it cashes out.
